significance: A Murugan temple at Neendoor in Kottayam district, built of laterite and teak with carved woodwork throughout and a monolithic stone lamp, where the deity is worshipped in his fierce form as commander of the divine armies after the killing of Tharakasuran. It is said to be the only Subrahmanya temple performing the Ottanarangamala Samarppanam.
story: The Pandavas and the sage Vyasa are said to have worshipped at this temple.
